turns.prompt_text: Would it be more practical for me to go on Facebook Marketplace or Craigslist to find one
turns.response_html:
Buying a refurbished Nintendo Switch on Facebook Marketplace or Craigslist can be a very practical and budget-friendly choice, but it comes with a few trade-offs you should consider.

Pros of Local Marketplaces

  • Lower Prices: You can often find standard Switch consoles for $150 to $200, which is significantly cheaper than standard refurbished retail options.
  • Included Extras: Many local sellers include physical games, carrying cases, and extra controllers (like a Pro Controller) in their bundles, providing excellent value.
  • No Tax or Shipping: You can pick it up today without paying extra fees.

Cons of Local Marketplaces

  • No Warranty or Return Policy: If the console stops working a week later or has hidden issues (like a weak battery or a scratch on the screen you didn't notice), you cannot return it.
  • Joy-Con Drift: Older, used Joy-Con controllers are notorious for "drift" (where the analog stick registers movement even when not touched). This is very common in used units.
  • Risk of Scams: You have to be cautious about meeting strangers and ensuring the device actually works before handing over cash.

How to Buy Safely Locally

If you decide to go the local route, here are a few critical steps:

  1. Meet in a Public Place: Meet at a local coffee shop or a police station "safe exchange" zone.
  2. Test Everything: Bring a game cartridge to test the reader, check the screen for dead pixels, and make sure both Joy-Cons connect and work correctly.
  3. Check for Bans: Ensure the console can connect to the internet and access the Nintendo eShop. If it can't, Nintendo may have banned the console due to tampering, making it impossible to play online.

If you are comfortable testing the device yourself and want the absolute best deal, Facebook Marketplace is a great option. However, if you prefer peace of mind and an easy return process, purchasing a Certified Refurbished model from a retailer might be worth the slightly higher price.
